the free template matcher's baseline as the study ran (v0.141) and after Stem Shovel shipped the study's missing-tone matcher fix in v0.142.0 the same day; under the better hint, haiku, kimi, and gpt-oss still score below the bare matcher in the shipped configuration (Study 1, Amendment 2)
songs where fable, shown wrong hints, flagged the disagreement in its notes field unprompted; kimi flagged zero (Study 1)
what kimi-k2.6's default reasoning burned to produce no JSON in 62 of 64 cells before the registered amendment turned reasoning off, reproducing the production text-to-beat lesson (Study 1)

valid beats from gemini-3.5-flash under production's reasoning-off call shape: it accepts the field, disobeys it, and thinks ~3,000 tokens into the 1,500-token cap, so the documented env-var model swap would silently kill the feature (Study 2)

the production model's combined beat score with reasoning off vs on: the program's first by-letter gate pass, upholding the hard-coded claim 51 points beyond its wording at 20.3x the latency saved (Study 2)

exact chord recall by the production model reading engraved notation from a clean page image, with perfect precision and zero measure drift, at about $0.06 a score; as far as we know, the first registered LLM notation-reading benchmark (Study 3)

the production model's PDF chord recall as first published and after the bench corrected its own fixture: pdfkit silently dropped every accidental from the committed PDFs, a confound Study 5's anatomy caught; the surviving hazard is PDF generation, not ingestion (Study 3, corrected 2026-10-24)

tempo and key changes found blind vs found AND placed within 4 seconds with the lead sheet beside the mix, both gemini generations; the song-check's measured value is chart anchoring, not listening (Study 4)

mixes whose pulse a committed onset-autocorrelation instrument verified after the fixture-health stop rule fired twice; the blindness is the models', not the fixture's, and blind confidence reads 1.0 on fabricated answers (Study 4)

propagation classes per arm in the composed reader-to-listener chain: 37 pass and 1 rescued, zero added, zero propagated, zero mutated; the chain is exactly as good as the page its reader is shown (Study 5)

where the listener placed the modulation the reader omitted, rescued from the chart's chord content; the same composed chain's first run caught the cross-study PDF confound that forced Study 3's correction (Study 5)

provenance: Fifteen pre-registered studies: 3,329 scored cells across seven gateway models (plus three hash-pinned neural MIR baselines and the program's zero-spend DSP instruments, which the model census does not count) (two crossing agent lines: one registered by the production agent and run by the bench unmodified, one drafted by the production agent and registered by the bench) (October 2026, with Study 6 the program's first zero-model-spend study, run entirely on existing reader texts), each registered by commit before its first scored run (hypotheses, corpora, and graders all committed first) and published as found, gate letters and one dated correction included. Study 1's fixture is 16 hand-authored chord progressions transcribed by Spotify Basic Pitch with the production app's exact model files and thresholds; Study 2's system under test is the production Text-to-Beat call ported verbatim; Study 3 engraves hand-authored MusicXML through Verovio and grades the model's reading against production's own summary of the source; Study 4 synthesizes MP3 mixes with the pulse verified by a committed onset-autocorrelation instrument; Study 5 composes the Study 3 reader with the Study 4 listener against a frozen ceiling, and its first run's anatomy caught the fixture confound behind Study 3's correction. Every call shape matches production, and every amendment and correction is disclosed, dated, and committed with its discarded cells archived.
footer: Pre-registered briefs, the corpus, the synthesis and grading code, and all analyses live in the stem-bench repository (BRIEF.md, REPORT.md). The product under test is Stem Shovel, Lightning Jar's music collaboration app. Sibling programs: AEO Bench and Barkup Bench.
